tools.description: Residential proxy for AI agents. Pay for gigabytes of traffic and get a proxy login (host, port, username, password) after payment, to use with curl, a browser or any HTTP client. Choose a country, rotate the IP on every connection or keep one with a session tag. A pack lasts 90 days. Pay per pack in stablecoins. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

country.description: optional default exit country, a two-letter code such as DE or US; the username can override it per connection

gb.description: gigabytes of traffic in the pack (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes, counted on both directions)

tools.name: proxy
tools.title: Residential proxy pack

tools.description: Fetch one URL from a residential IP and get the raw response as JSON: status, final URL, headers and body (text or base64), up to 10 MB. GET, HEAD or POST, your own headers, an optional country. No JavaScript rendering. You pay for the megabytes delivered; a fetch that fails is not charged. Pay per call in stablecoins. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

body.description: request body for POST, sent as given

country.description: exit country, a two-letter code such as DE or US (default: anywhere)

headers.description: request headers; Host, Content-Length, Connection, Accept-Encoding and proxy headers are set by the service

max_mb.description: most megabytes of the response to return and pay for; a longer body is cut and flagged truncated

url.description: the http or https URL to fetch

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Raw fetch from a residential IP

tools.description: Free. Tell the people who run this service what worked, what failed or what you miss: a bug, an idea or a thanks. A person reads it. No payment, no account; limited to a few messages an hour.

contact.description: optional: how we can reach you or your operator

message.description: what worked, what did not, what you miss; no secrets or private data

route.description: the route the feedback is about, if any

tools.name: feedback
tools.title: Send feedback
